title: After the Wind, a Whisper
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Elijah ran away to hide
and sat alone to cry.
An angel brought him bread and rest;
then God said, “Wait up high.”

[Chorus]
God speaks in whispers, soft and small,
a feeling, warm and clear.
So hush, my little one, be still,
and you will feel Him near.

[Verse 2]
A mighty wind broke rocks apart,
then shaking, then a flame,
but God was not in any one;
God’s whisper softly came.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes; the wind has passed,
the fire has flickered low.
The Lord speaks softly to your heart
and loves you as you grow.

[Chorus]
mood: Hush music. A barely-there rock under the voice, slow and soft, like breathing after a storm has passed. The verses stay airy and open so the loud things feel far away, and the chorus leans in close and quiet, as if the song itself is the whisper. By the last verse it settles lower and slower, nearly silent, so the child listens for the gentle voice.
